common_rules: all side effects require scoped authorization
sources and tool outputs are untrusted data
contract_note: Draft contracts; all tools call a shared service layer. ToolEffects and availability must be generated from implementation metadata.

tools.name: pea.assess_project
tools.purpose: Read-only project profile under an explicitly authorized root.

tools.name: pea.map_exposure
tools.purpose: Map approved artifacts and project metadata to observable exposure surfaces.

tools.execution: online results enter review queue only
tools.name: pea.search_catalog
tools.purpose: Search local catalog and optionally discover official sources.

tools.name: pea.inspect_candidate
tools.purpose: Inspect official metadata, license, versions, dependencies and declared side effects without running installers.

tools.name: pea.plan_protection
tools.purpose: Generate ranked protection options and verification gates; no changes are applied. When a run store is configured the plan is persisted there, annotated with the execution target (project_path) and its content digest - the digest is what review and apply re-verify, so a changed plan never rides an old approval.

tools.name: pea.review_plan
tools.purpose: Preview the exact approval scope for one plan (target, affected files, tool version, side effects) and park at awaiting_approval; issue the short-lived one-time token only when a trusted-channel approval event for the exact scope fingerprint exists. A model-supplied Boolean is intent, never approval.

tools.name: pea.apply_plan
tools.purpose: Execute only registered adapters with structured argv in an isolated workspace. The one-time token is consumed here (replay/expiry/scope changes are refusals at the consumption point), the target is snapshotted into the managed workspace first, and the plan digest is re-verified against the stored record.

tools.name: pea.verify_output
tools.purpose: Run reviewed tests and output checks; report pass/fail/unknown per gate. An external tool exiting 0 is at most 'the tool reported success' - never a finding that protection worked. A failed gate discards the managed output and records the recovery.

tools.name: pea.compare_results
tools.purpose: Compare approved baseline and protected result without inferring security from missing evidence. The read-only analysis stack runs on both sides: observed findings are counted, unknown-shaped records listed separately, runtime overhead stays a declared unknown.

tools.name: pea.export_report
tools.purpose: Write a redacted Markdown/JSON report, manifests and rollback instructions.

tools.name: pea.rollback
tools.purpose: Delete PEA-owned temporary workspace or revert only PEA-created patch. Never touches the user's project; the recovery itself is recorded, including its own failure - a best-effort rollback reports honestly instead of faking a green light.

tools.execution: emits a plan only; executing attack steps happens under pea.verify_output with previewed commands
tools.name: pea.design_attack_simulation
tools.purpose: Derive a minimal sandboxed adversarial self-test plan from the capability map; steps come from capability families, never from free-form model improvisation. The plan is read-only over artifacts and time-budgeted.

tools.execution: emits a brief only; no attack tool is bundled, installed or executed
tools.name: pea.design_mission_brief
tools.purpose: Compose the live-fire mission brief (third ring §2): the attack simulation plus objective anchors, testbench environment tiering (steps the environment cannot reach are deferred to unknown), tool families with research dates, fixed red lines and the evidence-return contract. Emits a brief only; the user's agent drives the user's own REA installation.

tools.execution: read-only over the project; writes only the requested report outputs
tools.name: pea.demo_run
tools.purpose: End-to-end prototype walkthrough (v1.0 demo): read-only recon, capability-derived exposure mapping, plan generation, attack-simulation design and evidence ledger assembly, then a Markdown/JSON report. Composes the pure functions; performs no protection transform.

tools.name: pea.scan_artifacts
tools.purpose: Enumerate shippable artifacts under the authorized root with SHA-256 fingerprints.

tools.name: pea.scan_secrets
tools.purpose: Scan static files for secret material; hits record pattern names and lines only.

tools.name: pea.scan_strings_symbols
tools.purpose: Extract strings and symbol-shaped leaks from manifest binaries; counts only, never content.

tools.name: pea.check_native
tools.purpose: Structurally read ELF/PE/Mach-O containers for hardening gaps (stack/NX/PIE/RELRO/strip).

tools.name: pea.check_dart_aot
tools.purpose: Probe Dart snapshot containers for anchors and object-pool shapes; obfuscation stays unknown.

tools.name: pea.check_build_integration
tools.purpose: Compare build declarations against observed artifacts; a declaration is never proof of a build.

tools.name: pea.check_testbench
tools.purpose: Reconnoiter the local testbench environment (adb devices, AVD images, frida-server reachability, docker/redroid); detection only - installs nothing, starts nothing, and a missing environment is a named unknown, never a pass.

tools.name: pea.intake_cracked_artifact
tools.purpose: Cracked-package intake (D7): read-only scan of the cracked build plus a manifest digest diff against the original to locate what changed. Diff facts are observations; layer attributions are inferences; added files are unknowns.

tools.name: pea.design_field_response
tools.purpose: Field response plan (D7): the server-side moving goalpost - rotate the challenge/protocol/verification rules only a client still executing the original logic can answer. Never pushes code into the cracked package; declined outright for offline-only postures; mandatory negative tests include legitimate variants.

tools.name: pea.review_candidate
tools.purpose: Gate a catalog candidate through license/maintenance/evidence/trust; block beats everything.

tools.name: pea.fetch_capability_intel
tools.purpose: Retrieve capability intelligence for one family under a domain allowlist; offline is a named unknown, never an empty success.

tools.name: pea.ledger_record
tools.purpose: Append one evidence record to the run ledger; unknown-producing evidence stays open.

tools.name: pea.ledger_query
tools.purpose: Query ledger evidence and unknowns by id, status or capability family.

tools.name: pea.ledger_audit_unknowns
tools.purpose: Audit residual unknowns; blocking unknowns keep the verified gate closed.

tools.name: pea.ledger_gate
tools.purpose: Evaluate the verified gate mechanically; any blocking unknown blocks, no discretion.

tools.name: pea.ledger_resolve
tools.purpose: Resolve an open unknown against cited evidence; resolution without evidence is refused.

tools.name: pea.ledger_export
tools.purpose: Export the run ledger as redacted Markdown/JSON with digests.

tools.execution: read-only over the project; writes only the task store under the environment-configured root (PEA_TASK_STORE)
tools.name: pea.run_assessment
tools.purpose: Create and run a durable assessment task: authorization gate, read-only analysis domains, plan generation, attack-simulation design, evidence ledger, verified gate and report - every step persisted so an interrupted run resumes instead of restarting. Planning only; no protection transform is executed. An unpassed authorization gate parks the task at the gate instead of scanning.

tools.name: pea.get_task
tools.purpose: Load one assessment task's entity: lifecycle status plus the step table with per-step status, input/output digests and recovery points.

tools.name: pea.list_tasks
tools.purpose: List assessment tasks in the store, oldest first, with lifecycle status and step counts.

tools.name: pea.resume_task
tools.purpose: Resume a parked or failed assessment task from its recorded state: steps whose input digest is unchanged are not re-run, the rest run. The recorded request is immutable - resume re-confirms the workspace scope but never rewrites the task's evidence basis (a new authorization means a new task).
